text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Yay! The sky's clearing up!
You really did try your best this time,
so it's only fair I give you top marks. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったわ！　
空が晴れていく……！
みんな、
よく頑張りました。
花丸あげちゃう♪

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
For real?!
That makes us like, ultra awesome!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジっ！？
花丸とかすごすぎなんだけど！

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Fair's fair, I say. We really did go through a lot.
Now then. The rain's let up, so let's enjoy this vacation its fullest!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
こんなに大変だったんだから当然よね。
さて、
雨もやんだし、
思いっきりバカンスを楽しみましょう！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, whiz-boy!
Let's play at the beach!
Come on, come on! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねね、
ヒデサイ！
一緒にビーチで遊ぼっか！
ほらほら、
れっつご～♪

text_block_list.name: Misaki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, no fair!
Wait up! I'm coming as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
スズナずるい！
アタシも行くから、
待ちなさいよ～！
